name: Ujugonggang
source:
In Between All Times is a cinematic-visual novel about a graduate student's struggles finding purpose and identity, set in a surreal future in the stars.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2917740/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《In Between All Times》是一部电影视觉小说，讲述了一名研究生努力寻找目标和身份的故事，背景设定在星空的超现实未来。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2917740/]Steam[/url]]
